name: public
_note: The machine behind the public repository: anyone who clones it installs as this machine. Owns no domain list, so every list applies to its bundle; harvest false and plan_tools false keep the memory export and the plan register tooling out; codex_first false leaves the Codex-first guard off until /setup records that Codex is installed (the answer lands in the home machine.local.json, which install.py merges over this file); publish true adds the README, LICENSE, notices and .gitignore from publish/ at the bundle root and writes clone-style install steps. Identities and gh account live in the home machine.local.json, written by /setup.
